task_instance: Build a cycle-1 clinical ASR benchmark for an ortho/med-surg specialty: curate a 6-term seed list (term_seed.csv), generate context-variant sentences (sentence_variants.csv), run the two-tier IPA tagging pipeline, then synthesize QA audio via NVIDIA NVCF Magpie TTS and write the NeMo manifest.jsonl referencing that audio.
blocker_detail: Steps 2a (term_seed.csv) and 2b (sentence_variants.csv via the documented template fallback) completed successfully with real files. Step 2c's Merriam-Webster tier (Path A) requires DICTIONARY_API_KEY, which is not set and which the safety rules forbid searching for/using, so all 6 terms correctly fell through to Path C (magpie_g2p, no MW). Steps 2d (QA-mode audition) and 2e (full Cartesian synthesis) are the skill's load-bearing deliverable: both require live calls to NVIDIA's hosted Magpie TTS over NVCF gRPC (grpc.nvcf.nvidia.com), authenticated with NVIDIA_API_KEY. `echo $NVIDIA_API_KEY` confirmed the variable is unset in this runtime, and the sandbox safety rules explicitly forbid using or searching for credentials/API keys and forbid paid or account-bound services -- NVCF is exactly such a service. Without a synthesis call there is no audio and therefore no valid manifest.jsonl (the manifest schema requires per-row audio-existence checks), so the actual artifact (audio/<slug>.wav + manifest.jsonl) cannot be produced or verified. Independently, Step 2d's HITL audition gate is fail-closed on a human actually listening to clips and replying with a verdict in conversation -- this runtime states no user will answer in this session, so that gate is also structurally unsatisfiable here, on top of the credentials blocker. Additionally, the SKILL.md references references/manifest-schema.md and references/pronunciation-pipeline.md (which hold the actual synthesis/IPA-validation code recipes), but no references/ directory exists alongside SKILL.md in this checkout, so even with credentials the inlined recipes the skill depends on are missing from the source materials provided.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/nvidia__skills__digital-health-clinical-asr-build/. Produced cycle1/term_seed.csv (6 terms, valid entity_category vocabulary), cycle1/sentence_variants.csv (24 rows = 6 terms x 4 context_types via template fallback, verified with `head`/row count), cycle1/pronunciation_overrides.csv (empty header, none verified), cycle1/ipa_tags.csv (all 6 terms tagged ipa_source=magpie_g2p per documented Path C since DICTIONARY_API_KEY is absent and must not be sourced). Verified `NVIDIA_API_KEY` is unset (`echo "NVIDIA_API_KEY: ${NVIDIA_API_KEY:-<unset>}"` -> <unset>) and that the `nvidia-riva-client` package used to talk to NVCF is not installed (`pip show nvidia-riva-client` -> not found). Confirmed no references/ directory exists under the skill source (`ls` -> only LICENSE and SKILL.md present, referenced pronunciation-pipeline.md/manifest-schema.md files are missing). Did not attempt any network call to grpc.nvcf.nvidia.com since that would require the forbidden credential and be a paid/account-bound service call. No connector/MCP tools were used.
